title: MTAF
description: This datapack adds a bit of magic, some general tweaks, and features, armor stand arms, lifesteal, and more!
body:
# MTAF
Min Version: 1.21.6 OR ELSE THERE WILL BE BUGS

Meletion\`s tweaks, and features is a quick little datapack I made, to fill a hole in survival minecraft.

MTAF is built with these goals in mind.
 - Multiplayer Friendly
 - Configurable
 - Helpful
 - Every feature being top quality
 - Every tweak being top quality
 - Having every feature documented well, since a lot of other projects don't.
 - Feeling vanilla



## Main Features
 - [World Config](https://github.com/Meletion/MTAF/wiki/Config)
 - [Magic](https://github.com/Meletion/MTAF/wiki/Magic)
 - [Coal To Gunpowder In Furnaces](https://github.com/Meletion/MTAF/wiki/Coal-To-Gunpowder-In-Furnaces)
 - [Armor Stand Arms](https://github.com/Meletion/MTAF/wiki/Armor-Stand-Arms)
 - [Death Coords](https://github.com/Meletion/MTAF/wiki/Death-Coords)
 - [LifeSteal](https://github.com/Meletion/MTAF/wiki/Lifesteal)
 - [Economy](https://github.com/Meletion/MTAF/wiki/Economy)

## Why?
This datapack adds a bunch of stuff, that fits into vanilla, while being useful to the player, and highly customizable.

# How do I use the config?
Do
```mcfunction
/function mtaf:config
```
in chat.
